title: External DKIM and DMARC runner request
description: Inputs accepted by Invoke-M365DomainAuthenticationRunner or its process script.

domain.description: Existing Microsoft 365 accepted domain to inspect or configure.

operation.description: Preview is read-only. Apply authorizes the engine's idempotent planned changes.

exchangeOrganization.description: Tenant domain used for Exchange Online app-only authentication.

exchangeCertificateThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of a runner-accessible certificate used for Exchange authentication.

dnsZone.description: Optional GoDaddy parent zone when the domain is a subdomain.

goDaddyTokenEnvironmentVariable.description: Name of a secret-provider-injected process environment variable containing the GoDaddy PAT.

reportDirectory.description: Protected artifact directory for apply snapshots and result reports.

resultFile.description: Optional file path whose existing parent directory is used to persist every returned result state, including adapter failures.
